title: Comparison of First and Second Proposals
body:
The first proposal includes equipment for 2500 units [First proposal](/page/86089bcf-f2ae-4984-ad26-2969f6d69c1f). The second proposal includes equipment for 3100 units [Second proposal](/page/a383b32e-743f-43cb-8be2-db8bf69db828).

Installation units are specified as 500 units in the first proposal [First proposal](/page/86089bcf-f2ae-4984-ad26-2969f6d69c1f). Installation units are also specified as 500 units in the second proposal [Second proposal](/page/a383b32e-743f-43cb-8be2-db8bf69db828).

Delivery time is two weeks in the first proposal [First proposal](/page/86089bcf-f2ae-4984-ad26-2969f6d69c1f). Delivery time is four weeks in the second proposal [Second proposal](/page/a383b32e-743f-43cb-8be2-db8bf69db828).

Total units are 3000 in the first proposal [First proposal](/page/86089bcf-f2ae-4984-ad26-2969f6d69c1f). Total units are 3600 in the second proposal [Second proposal](/page/a383b32e-743f-43cb-8be2-db8bf69db828).

Warranty period is one year in the first proposal [First proposal](/page/86089bcf-f2ae-4984-ad26-2969f6d69c1f). Warranty period is two years in the second proposal [Second proposal](/page/a383b32e-743f-43cb-8be2-db8bf69db828).
